map.录入课程安排，自动检测同一时间段的教师冲突与教室冲突，输出冲突清单与可视化课表。: Enter the timetable and the tool automatically detects teacher conflicts and classroom conflicts in the same time slot, then outputs a conflict list and a visual schedule.
map.排课前预检：把拟排课程（星期、节次、教师、教室）粘贴进工具，自动两两比对时间重叠: Pre-scheduling check: paste the proposed courses (weekday, period, teacher, classroom) into the tool; it compares every pair for time overlap and flags teacher conflicts (one teacher booked in two classes at the same time) and classroom conflicts (one classroom booked in two classes at the same time).
map.教室资源优化：通过教室冲突提示，发现同一教室被重复占用，及时调整或申请扩容，避免: Classroom resource optimisation: classroom conflict alerts reveal that the same room is double-booked, so you can adjust or request more rooms and avoid a scheduling clash.
map.教师工作量核查：教师冲突往往意味着排课对人手估算不足，提示需增派教师或错峰排课。: Workload check for teachers: teacher conflicts usually mean the timetable underestimated staffing, which signals the need for more teachers or staggered classes.
map.算例：3 门课同占周一第1-2节: Example: 3 classes all occupying Monday periods 1-2
map.冲突判定依据是什么？: What is the basis for conflict detection?
map.两门课若「星期相同」且节次区间交叉（a.start<b.end 且 b.star: If two classes fall on the same weekday and their period ranges overlap (a.start<b.end and b.start<a.end), they are flagged as a time conflict; on top of the time overlap the tool also compares teacher and classroom to record teacher conflicts and classroom conflicts separately. The tool only detects time and resource conflicts and says nothing about whether the course arrangement is reasonable.
map.能检测跨周或单双周冲突吗？: Can it detect conflicts across weeks or between single and alternate weeks?
map.当前按固定星期+节次比对，未区分单双周/隔周课；若课程含单双周安排，需把冲突周次: Comparison is currently done by fixed weekday plus period, without distinguishing single/alternate weeks. If a timetable contains single-week or alternate-week arrangements, list the conflicting week parities before comparing, or mark the week parity in the input so nothing is missed. The result is a reference for a first scheduling pass only.
